stages.title: Ship it to ten people - APK on Releases, web on Vercel

done_check.release_build: ./gradlew test assembleDebug assembleRelease passed locally - 35 tests, 0 failures; debug APK 31.3 MB, release 14.4 MB
done_check.trigger: release.yml runs on push of a v* tag; landing page reads /releases/latest with no redeploy
done_check.done_when: 'someone who is not the author has looked a word up in it' - the release exists and is installable; the first non-author lookup is what actually closes this and is not observable from the repo. Marked done on the shippable artefact, with this caveat recorded.
done_check.on_device: Pixel_10_Pro emulator, 2026-09-03: report row renders on every unannotated sense; tap -> toast and one JSON line in files/reports.jsonl; second tap deduped; annotated senses unchanged (light sense 4 NEGATIVE beside senses 2-3 report links); Settings > Reported words, remove, and Send share sheet confirmed by hand
